proposed_rule: two alphanumeric characters followed by seven digits
method: Trim source PWSIDs, count distinct nonempty IDs outside the proposed rule, and check exact membership in SDWIS PWSID values.
decision: Cole approved accepting nine-character alphanumeric exceptions only when they uniquely match the frozen SDWIS PWSID after trimming; preserve and flag the raw value. Unmatched or composite values go to review.
